name: execspec
description: Executable specification system: TypeScript-authored specs compile to canonical semantic IR, Swift is generated as an implementation target, and a harness verifies implementations over a language-neutral process protocol.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @execspec/core && npm run build -w @execspec/compiler && npm run build -w @execspec/dsl && npm run build -w @execspec/swift-generator && npm run build -w @execspec/ts-generator && npm run build -w @execspec/harness && npm run build -w @execspec/cli && npm run build -w @execspec/example-kv-spec && npm run build -w @execspec/example-kv-ts && npm run build -w @execspec/example-orders-spec && npm run build -w @execspec/example-orders-spec && npm run build -w @execspec/example-orders-ts && npm run build -w @execspec/example-menu-spec && npm run build -w @execspec/example-menu-ts && npm run build -w @execspec/example-billing-spec && npm run build -w @execspec/example-billing-ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/core && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/compiler && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/dsl && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/swift-generator && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/ts-generator && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/harness && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/cli && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/example-kv-spec && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/example-kv-ts && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/example-orders-spec && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/example-orders-spec && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/example-orders-ts && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/example-menu-spec && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/example-menu-ts && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/example-billing-spec && npm run typecheck -w @execspec/example-billing-ts
scripts.test: npm run test -w @execspec/core && npm run test -w @execspec/compiler && npm run test -w @execspec/dsl && npm run test -w @execspec/swift-generator && npm run test -w @execspec/ts-generator && npm run test -w @execspec/harness && npm run test -w @execspec/cli && npm run test -w @execspec/example-kv-spec && npm run test -w @execspec/example-orders-spec && npm run test -w @execspec/example-orders-spec && npm run test -w @execspec/example-orders-ts && npm run test -w @execspec/example-menu-spec && npm run test -w @execspec/example-menu-ts && npm run test -w @execspec/example-billing-spec && npm run test -w @execspec/example-billing-ts
scripts.test:swift: swift test --package-path targets/swift-runtime && swift test --package-path examples/kv-swift && swift test --package-path examples/orders-swift && swift test --package-path examples/menu-swift && swift test --package-path examples/billing-swift
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:swift && npm run acceptance
